message: The other day, I was rummaging through our go-bags, and I realized I had packed everything except a single pair of socks! I mean, who needs a flashlight when you could go commando? 😂 It was a funny reminder that preparedness is about the little things, too. I’ve since made a checklist to ensure we’re not just ready in the big ways, but in the small, silly ones as well. What’s your go-to tip for being prepared without losing your sense of humor?
